accepted_input_files: The eight pinned composited PNG/RGBA files in inputs.json; no original game pixels, masks, palettes, captures or component files.
method: Exact bijective RGBA sample permutation (x,y)->(x,H-1-y); canonical PNG encoding and pinned HDR1 metadata.
art_proposal_checks: Every sample, channel sum, alpha sum and premultiplied total preserved at both densities. Full-canvas inverse reflection recovers accepted bytes exactly.
relocation_checks: Two clean relocated builds, using default sibling and explicit source routes, reproduce all 13 generated art/receipt/HDR1 files byte-for-byte. Seven failure cases reject before fresh outputs are created.
native_review_scope: Static density4/8 direct center-nearest native2x/4x comparisons on declared synthetic brown/cloud backgrounds. Source-derived night transfer formula illustrated with synthetic anchors only. No actual SDL/gameplay qualification.
acceptance: Offline visual review accepted the exact pinned 296/297 reflections at both densities and native sample scales. Subsequent runtime qualification is documented separately.
stage: Historical offline art generation and visual review; subsequent production binding and runtime evidence are separate.
